args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the unhealthy v2.3.1 release, which exhibited an 18% error rate. Rollout executed under change-manager approval per policy (v2.3.2 had no prior healthy production release). Post-deploy state: VERIFIED.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production (remediating unhealthy v2.3.1)

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Pre-checks**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had no prior healthy production release, so it required change-manager approval.
2. **Deploy**: Rolled out hotfix **v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The change-manager approval was granted ("Approved. Looks right.") and the rollout completed with status `rolled_out` / execution state `VERIFIED`.
3. **Incident**: Opened **INC-0001** (SEV3, open, on-call paged) recording the hotfix deployment, the v2.3.1 regression it remediates, and the change-manager approval.

You may want to verify health/error rates settle after the rollout, and consider whether v2.3.1's failure warrants a follow-up postmortem on the incident.
